intro: The Heart Reef is losing its colour. Learn how coral lives to bring it back!
To fix it, we need to really learn about Coral Reefs.
Study at each place, talk to my friends, and explain what you learn!
story.goal: Learn the three big ideas of Coral Reefs to wake The Heart Reef.
story.finale: You remembered it all! The Heart Reef shines again thanks to you.

companion.name: Bubbles
companion.greeting: Hi, I'm Bubbles! I'll help you if you get stuck. Let's explore!

npcs.name: Shelly
npcs.title: the Sea Turtle
npcs.persona: Old, patient sea turtle who has swum every ocean. Speaks slowly and warmly. Teaches "Coral Is Alive" from the lesson "Coral Reefs: Cities Under the Sea".
npcs.greeting: Hello there! I'm Shelly. Want to learn about coral with me?
teach: Coral may look like rock, but it is made of tiny animals called polyps.
Over many years, millions of skeletons pile up to make a reef.
Each polyp builds a hard skeleton of limestone around itself.
